stages.name: Liquid nitrogen reservoir (1.2 L, surrounds central heat-exchanger support tube)
stages.quote: The cryostat's liquid nitrogen is stored in a reservoir, which surrounds the central heat exchanger support tube, but is thermally isolated from it.

stages.name: Heat exchanger with heater and PT100 sensor (sample holder bolts to it; 77.2-500 K)
stages.quote: Liquid nitrogen is supplied to the heat exchanger through a capillary tube connected to the reservoir. The flow of liquid is aided by gravity, but the flow rate is controlled by the exhaust valve at the top of the cryostat.

stages.name: Outer vacuum chamber (OVC), room temperature, pumped < 1e-4 mbar, held by charcoal sorb on reservoir
stages.quote: The reservoir and sample holder are thermally isolated from the room temperature surroundings by the outer vacuum chamber (OVC). This space is pumped to a high vacuum before the cryostat is cooled down, and the vacuum is maintained by a small sorption pump fitted to the reservoir.

Max sample space 20 mm diameter; sample holder 20 mm wide x 50 mm long. No cold (radiation-shield) windows.

notes: Compact tabletop LN2 bath optical cryostat, 175 x 175 x 450 mm, 5 kg (manual Table 3-5 and 7.3). Top: LN2 fill/vent pipe, nitrogen exhaust flow needle valve, two 10-pin connectors (diagnostic, experimental) on the OVC top plate, DN16NW OVC evacuation port with pressure-relief plates. Inside: 1.2 L LN2 reservoir around a central heat-exchanger support tube; capillary feeds a gravity-fed heat exchanger carrying heater + PT100; sample holder (20 x 50 mm) bolts beneath, sample in vacuum ('No cold windows', no radiation-shield windows). Four radial Spectrosil WF windows + one axial blank, each held by four nylon screws and an O-ring, 35 mm clear aperture, f/1 (QD Oxford page: 'Large illumination area: 35 mm diameter window aperture'; 'Weight: 5 kg'). Charcoal sorb with 150 ohm heater on the reservoir keeps the OVC below 1e-4 mbar. 77.2-500 K, +/-0.1 K, cooldown 20 min, hold >= 15 h. No cryocooler, no magnet; only motion is LN2 boil-off vapour at the vent and the optional external pump. Sources: QD Oxford Optistat matrix PDF (OPTSS 0926 R5, cache c73e273061693731), QD Oxford product page https://www.qd-oxford.com/products/optistat_spectroscopy.html (cache 295cbbaf14723ca3), Oxford Instruments Optistat family brochure (cache d52046bdb551703d), Oxford Instruments Optistat DN-V Operators Manual Issue 2.0 Dec 2020 (andor.oxinst.com robots.txt disallows the snapshot script; PDF fetched via WebFetch and text extracted locally with pypdf into the session scratchpad).
